# DSP Architecture: O-Strata (v2 — live wave-terrain oscillator)

## Core Components

Components 1–10 are new or changed. Component 11 lists what is inherited unchanged. Ordering follows the signal path.

### 1. TerrainOscillator (replaces WavetableOscillator in place)
- **JUCE Class:** Custom implementation (`dsp/TerrainOscillator.h/.cpp`); uses `juce::SmoothedValue` (juce_audio_basics), `juce::dsp::FastMathApproximations::tanh` (juce_dsp, verified `juce_FastMathApproximations.h:108`), `juce::jlimit`.
- **Purpose:** FUNC-01. Per voice, per oscillator: a closed orbit at the note frequency scans a terrain per sample; θ is the phase accumulator so Sync / Bend / Window / FM warps, unison and Phase apply unchanged.
- **Parameters Affected:** all 17 new per-oscillator parameters + inherited `osc?Pos` (Orbit Size), `osc?Unison/Detune/Width/Phase/WarpType/WarpAmt/Coarse/Fine`.
- **Configuration:**
  - **Public interface = `WavetableOscillator`'s, minus `setWavetable`** (recorded from `plugins/O-Strata/Source/dsp/WavetableOscillator.h:45-63`): `prepare(double sampleRate)`, `setFrequency(double)`, `setPosition(float)`, `reset()`, `resetWithPhase(double)`, `resetWithRandomPhases()`, `getNextSampleStereo(double& L, double& R)`, `setUnison(int count, float detune, float width)`, `setWarpType(WarpType)`, `setWarpAmount(float)`, `setFMInput(double)`, `getFrequency()`. The voice's call sites (`StrataVoice.cpp:147-148, 254-291, 383-384, 473-480, 533-534, 577-590, 594-595`) compile unchanged after `WavetableOscillator oscA, oscB` → `TerrainOscillator oscA, oscB` (`StrataVoice.h:187-188`) and the two `setWavetableA/B` methods are removed.
  - **New setters.** Block-rate (called once per `renderNextBlock`): `setTerrain(TerrainKind)`, `setOrbit(OrbitKind)`, `setQuality(Quality)`, `setPitchTrack(float)`, `setFeedbackDamp(float)`, `setEdgeMode(EdgeMode)`, `setTerrainImage(const TerrainImage*)`, `setChebyshevSet(const ChebyshevSet*)`, `updateBlockRate(double noteHz)` (pitch-track ratio, damp coefficient — the only `pow` calls, per block). Per-sample (called every base sample from the voice's mod section, values already smoothed + modulated by the voice, Core 9): `setPosition` (Orbit Size, inherited), `setAspect`, `setRotation`, `setCentre(x, y)`, `setOrbitMod`, `setTerrainFreq`, `setTerrainMod(x, y)`, `setFeedback`, `setSaturation`. Setters store floats; no computation.
  - **Phase convention:** `phaseAccumulators[i]` ∈ [0, 1) exactly as today (`WavetableOscillator.cpp:210-268`); θ = 2π · `applyWarp(phase)`. `readSample(phase)` is replaced by `scan(phase, partial)` = orbit(θ) → feedback displacement → clamp → terrain → clamp → saturation. The Sync / Window branch (`WavetableOscillator.cpp:221-244`) and the Bend / FM branch (`applyWarp`, `.cpp:183-202`) are copied verbatim; only the read call changes. `isfinite` guard on the phase kept (`.cpp:138-141`).
  - **Oversampling loop inside `getNextSampleStereo`:** for OS ∈ {1, 2, 4}: run the per-partial scan OS times with phase increment `phaseIncrement / OS`, holding every parameter constant over the sub-samples (must-have 1), feed the OS sub-samples to the partial's HalfbandDecimator (Core 5), take one base-rate sample. Warp state (`masterPhases`, sync re-seed) advances per sub-sample, so Sync resets gain sub-sample resolution — an improvement, not a parity break (θ parity is tested against the analytic sine, Harness §H1).
  - **Unison:** `kMaxUnison = 4` (was 8, must-have 6, PERF-02); `setUnison` clamps to 4; detune / pan / gain laws unchanged (`WavetableOscillator.cpp:104-131`). Every partial owns its own θ, feedback state (`d`, `y1`, `y2`) and decimator.
  - **Output conditioning:** per oscillator L/R after the unison sum: one-pole DC blocker `y[n] = x[n] − x[n−1] + R·y[n−1]`, R = 1 − 2π·5 Hz / fs (FUNC-04 "no DC runaway": a static orbit sitting on a hill is pure DC otherwise; the wavetable path removed DC at bake time). The feedback tap reads the pre-blocker scan value, per partial.
  - **Per-sample budget (DSP-05):** no `pow`, no `std::function`, no allocation; `switch` on `TerrainKind` / `OrbitKind` enums; fast tanh; the Saturation branch is skipped exactly when the smoothed saturation is 0 (identity at 0 is exact, DSP-07).

### 2. OrbitLibrary (11 closed curves)
- **JUCE Class:** Custom implementation (`dsp/Orbits.h`, `inline` functions + one 2-D LUT for Superellipse built in `prepare`)
- **Purpose:** FUNC-03. Base orbit b(θ) with unit max radius, then affine: aspect (b_x, a·b_y), rotation ρ, scale r (Orbit Size), translate c (Centre X/Y).
- **Parameters Affected:** `osc?Orbit`, `osc?Pos` (r = 0.05 + 0.95·pos), `osc?OrbAspect`, `osc?OrbRot`, `osc?OrbCX`, `osc?OrbCY`, `osc?OrbMod` (m)
- **Configuration:** clean-room formulas (mathematics, not code — *Terrain* is GPL-3.0). K = trigonometric-polynomial degree of (x(θ), y(θ)) (drives the Chebyshev bound, Core 6). All curves are normalised to max radius 1 over θ at m = 0.5 and re-normalised per block for the current m (one 64-point scan per block when m changed by > 1e-3; no per-sample cost).

| # | Orbit | Base curve (before aspect / rotation / size / centre) | Orbit Mod m ∈ [0,1] | K | Bandlimited |
|---|-------|--------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|---|-------------|
| 0 | Ellipse | x = cos θ, y = sin θ (aspect makes it an ellipse) | inert (documented) | 1 | exact |
| 1 | Superellipse | r(θ) = (|cos θ|ⁿ + |sin θ|ⁿ)^(−1/n), x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ | n = 0.5 + 5.5·m (n = 2 ⇒ circle) | — | approximate |
| 2 | Limaçon | r(θ) = 1 + a·cos θ, a = 2m (inner loop for a > 1) | loop size a | 2 | exact |
| 3–5 | Epitrochoid p (p = 3, 5, 7) | x = (p+1)cos θ − d·cos((p+1)θ), y = (p+1)sin θ − d·sin((p+1)θ), d = 0.1 + 2.9·m | inner-pen distance d (lobe depth) | p+1 (4, 6, 8) | exact |
| 6–8 | Hypocycloid p (p = 3, 5, 7) | x = (p−1)cos θ + d·cos((p−1)θ), y = (p−1)sin θ − d·sin((p−1)θ), d = 0.1 + 1.9·m | cusp depth d | p−1 (2, 4, 6) | exact |
| 9 | Butterfly | r(θ) = e^{cos θ} − 2cos 4θ + w·sin⁵θ, w = 2m; x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ (2π-periodic; the classical sin⁵(θ/12) term is replaced by a 2π-periodic wing term so the curve closes once per cycle) | wing asymmetry w | ∞ (e^{cos θ} decays as Iₙ(1): effectively ≤ 12 at −100 dB) | approximate |
| 10 | Squarcle | x = tanh(k cos θ)/tanh k, y = tanh(k sin θ)/tanh k, k = 0.3 + 6·m (k → 0 circle, k large square) | corner sharpness k | ∞ | approximate |

  - **No `pow` in the audio path:** Superellipse reads r(θ, n) from a 33 (n) × 129 (θ over one quadrant, symmetric) float LUT (17 KB) built in `prepare`, bilinear; Butterfly uses `std::exp` (≈ 5 ns on Apple libm, §7.2) and sin⁵ = s²·s²·s; Squarcle uses `FastMathApproximations::tanh` with 1/tanh k cached per block. Bench costs (§7.2 `bench-output.txt`): ellipse 12 ns, epitrochoid-7 14 ns, butterfly 29 ns (with `pow` — ≈ 20 ns without), superellipse 47 ns with `pow` → ≈ 8 ns via LUT.
  - **Parity / symmetry class** (for DSP-06): all base curves are centrosymmetric except Limaçon (a > 0), Butterfly (w > 0) and the epitrochoid / hypocycloid families with odd p (p-fold symmetry, not 2-fold). The off-centre default (c = (0.13, 0.21), aspect 0.7) breaks the symmetry for every orbit.

### 3. TerrainLibrary (6 analytic terrains)
- **JUCE Class:** Custom implementation (`dsp/Terrains.h`)
- **Purpose:** FUNC-02. f(x, y) ∈ [−1, 1] over [−1, 1]², with effective spatial frequency F (Core 9 / Algorithm "Pitch tracking") and two shape inputs mx, my ∈ [0, 1].
- **Parameters Affected:** `osc?Terrain`, `osc?TerFreq`, `osc?TerModX`, `osc?TerModY`, `osc?TerTrack`
- **Configuration:** **spatial-frequency convention is πF per unit** (F = 1 ⇒ one full sine cycle across [−1, 1]). Decided by the Stage 0 sweep: with sin(πF x)·sin(πF y), r = 0.5, c = (0.13, 0.21), aspect 0.7, F = 1 → h1 is the strongest partial (0 dB), 5 partials above −40 dB; the 2πF convention at the same defaults gives h1 = −46 dB (gate failure). Formulas (clean-room; Mitsuhashi's polynomial is from the 1982 paper via Mills & de Souza 1999):

| # | Terrain | f(x, y) | Mod X (mx) | Mod Y (my) | Symmetry (centred orbit) | Cheb. fit at F=1 / 2 |
|---|---------|---------|------------|------------|--------------------------|----------------------|
| 0 | Sine Product | sin(πF·x + π(mx − ½)) · sin(πF·(½ + my)·y) | pattern phase along x | y-frequency ratio 0.5–1.5 | even at defaults → octave up | 100 % / 100 % |
| 1 | Radial Rings | cos(2πF·(½ + mx)·ρ + 2π(my − ½)), ρ = √(x² + y²) | ring spacing | ring phase | even (radial) → octave up; centred circle ⇒ DC | 100 % / 94 % |
| 2 | Saddle | sin(πF·(x² − y² + 2(mx − ½)·xy) + π(my − ½)) | saddle skew (axis rotation) | phase (ripple offset) | even at defaults | 100 % / 99.9 % |
| 3 | Ridged Cosines | 1 − |cos(πF·x + π(mx − ½))| − |cos(πF·(½ + my)·y)| | ridge phase | y-frequency ratio | even at defaults; C⁰ corners (broadband — the "feedback lead" terrain) | 99.5 % / 96.8 % |
| 4 | Mitsuhashi | 1.747·(u − v)(u² − 1)(v² − 1), u = tri(F·x), v = tri(F·(½ + my)·y), where tri() is the triangle wrap into [−1, 1] and the (u − v) factor is rotated by α = mx·π/2: (u cos α − v sin α) | rotation of the (x − y) factor | y-frequency ratio | **odd** → centred plays the right pitch with odd harmonics only | 100 % / 100 % |
| 5 | Cosine Wells | 1 − 2·hᵖ, h = ½(1 + cos(2πF·x)·cos(2πF·(½ + mx)·y)), p = 1 + 6·my (fractional power via lerp between integer powers, no `pow`) | y-frequency ratio | well depth / sharpness | even → octave up | 98 % / 76 % |
| 6 | Imported… | bilinear read of the pre-blurred PNG (Core 8) | — | — | image-dependent | at import (Algorithm "PNG → Chebyshev") |

  - Costs (§7.2): sine product ≈ 22 ns (28 with tanh), rings / saddle ≈ 25–38 ns (one `sqrt` + trig), Mitsuhashi ≈ 10 ns (polynomial), wells ≈ 30 ns, image bilinear 29 ns.
  - All formulas are bounded in [−1, 1] by construction (Mitsuhashi normalised by its measured peak 0.5724 on [−1, 1]²); the oscillator still clamps the scanned value (1 op) because the Chebyshev projection can overshoot (Gibbs).

### 4. TrajectoryFeedback
- **JUCE Class:** Custom implementation (inside `TerrainOscillator`, per partial state)
- **Purpose:** FUNC-04. The previous scan value displaces the next orbit point.
- **Parameters Affected:** `osc?OrbFeedback` (fb, per-sample), `osc?OrbFbDamp` (block-rate)
- **Configuration:**
  - `p[n] = orbit(θ[n]) + fb · d[n] · û`, `d[n] = a · d[n−1] + (1 − a) · ½(y[n−1] + y[n−2])`, `d` clamped to [−0.5, 0.5], `p` clamped to [−1, 1]² (DSP-04), `y = clamp(f(p), −1, 1)`.
  - `û` = the orbit's rotation vector (cos ρ, sin ρ) — "a fixed direction rotated with the orbit" (BRIEF).
  - **Two-sample average** ½(y[n−1] + y[n−2]) is the Tomisawa anti-hunting zero at Nyquist (memory `O-simpleFM`: single-sample self-feedback hunts into a Nyquist limit cycle). It is what makes Damp = 0 usable.
  - **Damp law:** a = 1 − 2^(−1 − 9·Damp) at 48 kHz, 1× (Damp 0 → 0.5, 0.5 → 0.978, 1 → 0.999); corrected per block for rate and oversampling: a_eff = a^(48000 / (fs · OS)) so the displacement time constant is the same at 4× and at 96 kHz (feedback runs per sub-sample at 2× / 4×).
  - **Boundedness (Stage 0 analysis):** y ∈ [−1, 1] (clamp) ⇒ the leaky integrator's output is bounded by 1 without any clamp (a ∈ [0.5, 1), |input| ≤ 1); the ±0.5 clamp is stricter. p is clamped into the terrain domain, so f is always evaluated where it is defined and bounded. The only NaN sources are non-finite inputs: θ is `isfinite`-guarded (inherited), `d` is NaN-scrubbed (`if (!isfinite(d)) d = 0`, one compare) and reset at note-on together with `y1`, `y2`. Worst-case gain is therefore 1 (no runaway is possible; chaos and limit cycles are the feature). Verified numerically over Feedback × Damp × {1×, 4×} at C4: finite everywhere, max |y| = 0.998.
  - **DC:** the displacement's DC component is the "spatial compression" (the orbit drifts toward a hill/valley) and is intended — the 3D view shows the displaced trail. No DC blocker on `d`; the output DC blocker (Core 1) handles the audio.
  - **Feedback 0 contract:** with fb = 0.0f, `p = orbit + 0·d` is bit-identical to the path removed because `d` is finite (0·finite = 0, x + 0 = x in IEEE-754); `d` keeps integrating (4 ops) so it is warm when fb rises. Gate: Harness §H3.

### 5. HalfbandDecimator + Quality
- **JUCE Class:** Custom per-sample polyphase-IIR half-band decimator (`dsp/HalfbandDecimator.h`), coefficients designed once in `prepare` by `juce::dsp::FilterDesign<float>::designIIRLowpassHalfBandPolyphaseAllpassMethod(tw, stopbandDb)` (juce_dsp, verified `juce_Oversampling.cpp:283-289` uses exactly this). **Not** `juce::dsp::Oversampling` (Decision 5).
- **Purpose:** DSP-03, FUNC-06. Per-oscillator, per-partial 2× / 4× oversampling; the voice loop, filters, LFOs and mod matrix stay at base rate.
- **Parameters Affected:** `osc?Quality` (Bandlimited / 2× / 4×)
- **Configuration:**
  - **Decimation only.** The oscillator synthesises at OS·fs, so no upsampler exists; JUCE's `Oversampling` is block-oriented (`processSamplesUp` / `processSamplesDown` on `AudioBlock`, `juce_Oversampling.h:144-151`) and always pairs up + down. A block API would break the per-sample FM cross-feed `oscA.setFMInput(lastOscBOut)` (`StrataVoice.cpp:589-590`) and the per-sample mod destinations.
  - **2× stage:** two all-pass paths, 2 second-order sections each (4 coefficients; the bench `Halfband2x` structure, `kernels.h`): stopband ≈ −70 dB, transition width 0.06·fs (JUCE's n = 0 design: tw 0.12 × 0.5). Cost 9 ns per base sample (§7.2). `down(x_even, x_odd)` per base sample.
  - **4× stage:** cascade — stage A (4× → 2×) with the wider n = 1 design (tw 0.15, ≥ −60 dB; 1–2 sections per path), then the 2× stage. Cost ≈ 9 + 5 ns.
  - **Latency:** group delay at DC of the 2× decimator = 2.29 sub-samples per path (computed from the bench coefficients: Σ 2(1 − a)/(1 + a), delayed path + 1) = **1.15 base samples**; 4× ≈ 1.4 base samples; Bandlimited 0. Reported as a **constant 1 sample** added to the existing distortion-oversampler latency in `prepareToPlay` and `timerCallback` (`PluginProcessor.cpp:722, 1007-1011`), independent of Quality (Decision 5: per-oscillator, automatable Quality cannot report per-path latency; ≤ 0.4 sample of inter-path skew is inaudible for a synth). The exact value is read from the designed coefficients in `prepare` and asserted ≤ 2.
  - **No allocation on a Quality change (DSP-05, PERF-01):** every partial owns both stages permanently (state = 4 + 4 floats per stage; ≈ 64 B per partial); `setQuality` flips an enum. Switching while a note is held: the new path starts from the current θ; the decimator state of the newly selected path is reset and the output crossfades over 64 base samples (equal-gain linear, both paths run for 64 samples). Pre-allocation total: 16 voices × 2 osc × 4 partials × 2 stages ≈ 16 KB.
  - **Design in `prepare`:** `FilterDesign` allocates (`juce::Array`), so it runs in `prepare` only (not RT); the allpass coefficients are copied into a fixed `std::array<float, 4>` per stage.

### 6. ChebyshevTerrain (Bandlimited mode)
- **JUCE Class:** Custom implementation (`dsp/ChebyshevSet.h`: triangle of coefficients c_nm, n + m ≤ 16, 153 floats; Clenshaw evaluator; `dsp/ChebyshevProjector.h/.cpp`: Chebyshev–Gauss quadrature + separable DCT-like contraction)
- **Purpose:** DSP-02. Terrain f = Σ c_nm T_n(x) T_m(y); with a trig-polynomial orbit of degree K the output is a trigonometric polynomial with maximum harmonic (n + m)·K, so coefficients above the per-pitch bound are dropped exactly like a mip level. Verified §7.2: −116 dB floor at 1×, ellipse + offset preserves the bound.
- **Parameters Affected:** `osc?Quality` = Bandlimited; `osc?Terrain`, `osc?TerFreq`, `osc?TerModX`, `osc?TerModY`, `osc?TerBlur`, `osc?TerEdge` (through the set), `osc?Orbit` (K)
- **Configuration:**
  - **Set:** total degree ≤ 16 (153 coefficients). Evaluation: 2-D Clenshaw over the triangle (skipping the zero upper triangle — ≈ 55 % of the 16×16 tensor work): ≤ 57 ns measured for the full tensor (§7.2), ≈ 35 ns expected for the triangle. No tanh unless Saturation > 0.
  - **Per-pitch truncation (per voice, per block):** D_max = clamp(⌊0.5·fs / (K·f_note)⌋ − 1, 1, 16); coefficients with n + m > D_max are masked. Table at 48 kHz (Stage 0): Ellipse K = 1: C2/C4/C6/C8 → 16/16/16/4; Hypocycloid 3 (K = 2): 16/16/10/1; Epitrochoid 3 (K = 4): 16/16/4/1; Epitrochoid 7 (K = 8): 16/10/1/1. High-K orbits get dull, not aliased, at the top — correct mip behaviour; the UI readout states it ("Bandlimited · 12 partials at C4"). A raised-cosine taper over the top two diagonals (n + m ∈ {D_max − 1, D_max}) avoids clicks when D_max changes under glide / pitch mod (memory `O-simpleAdditive`).
  - **Terrain Freq in Bandlimited mode is clamped to [0.25, 2.0]** and Pitch Track is inert: the fit of a degree-16 triangle to the analytic terrains under the πF convention is ≥ 94 % up to F = 2 for five terrains (Cosine Wells 76 %) and collapses above (Sine Product 24 % at F = 4). The harmonic count of a Chebyshev terrain is pitch-invariant by construction, so the mip is the truncation, not a spatial-frequency scaling (Decision 3). The Terrain-tab readout shows the projection fit ("fit 99 %").
  - **Where mod-matrix routes go in this mode:** Orbit destinations (Size, Aspect, Rotation, Centre X/Y, Orbit Mod, Feedback, Saturation) stay audio-rate. The three terrain destinations (Terrain Freq, Mod X, Mod Y) are **block-rate at the swap cadence** (BRIEF): global sources (ModWheel, Aftertouch — processor atomics) are folded into the coefficient key by the scheduler at 20 Hz; per-voice sources (LFO1–4, envelopes, Velocity, NoteNum) are bypassed for those three destinations in this mode (documented in the UI readout; Decision 3 lists the "F-lattice" upgrade that would make Terrain Freq per-voice block-rate in v1.1).
  - **Exactness:** exact for Ellipse, Limaçon, Epitrochoid 3/5/7, Hypocycloid 3/5/7 with Feedback = 0; approximate (readout says so) for Superellipse / Butterfly / Squarcle and whenever Feedback > 0 (the displacement is not a trig polynomial of θ).
  - **Crossfade on swap:** when the voice sees a new `ChebyshevSet*` at block start it evaluates both sets for that one block and crossfades linearly (equal-gain: both are the same signal family). The old set outlives the crossfade because the reaper frees it only two block generations after retirement (Core 7).

### 7. ChebyshevScheduler (off-audio-thread coefficient sets, atomic swap)
- **JUCE Class:** `juce::Timer` (juce_events, message thread, 50 ms), `juce::ThreadPool` (1 thread, "O-Strata Chebyshev") + `juce::ThreadPoolJob`, `juce::MessageManager::callAsync`, existing `std::atomic<const T*>` publish + generation-counted reaper (`PluginProcessor.h:288-303`, `.cpp:994-1024`) generalised to a type-erased `Retirable` (Decision 6).
- **Purpose:** DSP-02 "coefficient sets computed off the audio thread and swapped atomically"; PERF-01.
- **Parameters Affected:** reads `osc?Terrain`, `osc?TerModX`, `osc?TerModY`, `osc?TerBlur`, `osc?TerEdge`, `osc?Quality`, `osc?TerFreq` (clamped) + the ModWheel / Aftertouch fold for the three terrain destinations + `imageGeneration[osc]`.
- **Configuration (adapted from superseded Core 8):**
  - Runs only while `osc?Quality == Bandlimited` for that oscillator (otherwise the key is not even hashed — the 2×/4× paths never wait on it).
  - `ChebKey` = FNV-1a over (terrain, F_clamped, ModX_eff, ModY_eff, blur, edge, imageGeneration). Polled every 50 ms; **debounce 50 ms** (not the superseded 150 ms: an analytic projection costs ≈ 0.1–1 ms, see Algorithm "Chebyshev projection"); one in-flight job per oscillator, newer key cancels the older via `signalJobShouldExit()`; result dropped on key mismatch at publish.
  - Publish (`callAsync`, `JUCE_ASSERT_MESSAGE_THREAD`): `chebPtr[osc].store(new, release)`; `retire(old)`; `chebGeneration[osc]++` (editor readout). Voices `load(acquire)` per block in `updateOscillatorAssignments()` (the renamed `updateWavetableAssignments`, `PluginProcessor.cpp:1028-1049`).
  - `prepareToPlay` and `setStateInformation` never publish (state restore bumps the key; the timer does the rest) — the "swap needs a lock if prepareToPlay publishes" trap does not apply.
  - Destructor: `pool.removeAllJobs(true, 2000)` before voices are destroyed.
  - Initial state: `chebPtr = nullptr` → the oscillator falls back to the analytic terrain at 1× until the first set arrives (≤ 100 ms); never silence.

### 8. TerrainImage (PNG import, decode, pre-blur, edge, publish, Chebyshev projection)
- **JUCE Class:** `juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom` / `juce::PNGImageFormat` (juce_graphics), `juce::FileChooser::launchAsync` with `juce::Component::SafePointer` (juce_gui_basics; memory `pattern_webview_launchasync_safepointer_no_complete`), `juce::Base64`, `juce::SHA256` (juce_cryptography, already linked `CMakeLists.txt:61`), `juce::ThreadPool` (shared with Core 7), `std::atomic<const TerrainImage*> imagePtr[2]` + reaper.
- **Purpose:** FUNC-07, DSP-04, FUNC-08 (with State Persistence).
- **Parameters Affected:** `osc?Terrain == Imported…`, `osc?TerBlur`, `osc?TerEdge`
- **Configuration:**
  - `TerrainImage` = immutable: W × H float luminance in [−1, 1] (W, H ≤ 1024; larger images are box-downsampled at decode — pixel detail beyond a 2048-sample orbit's resolution is broadband anyway), the pre-blurred copy for the current Blur (σ = blur · W/32 px, separable Gaussian, superseded Core 5), Edge Mode, and the Chebyshev triangle projected at import for Bandlimited mode (Algorithm "PNG → Chebyshev").
  - Decode + blur + projection run in an import job (background). Blur / Edge changes re-run blur + projection through the same job with a 150 ms debounce (a 1024² blur ≈ 10–20 ms). The audio thread only ever reads the published pointer.
  - Read: bilinear over the pre-blurred copy; orbit already clamped to [−1, 1]² and `isfinite`-guarded (Core 4); Mirror reflects coordinates at ±1 (even extension, C⁰ across the edge); Window multiplies by w(x)·w(y), w(u) = ½(1 + cos πu) (Mitsuhashi boundary condition). Cost 29 ns (§7.2).
  - F for images: the image spans [−1, 1]² at F = 1; F > 1 tiles it through the edge rule (Mirror) or windows it (Window) — the same read with scaled coordinates.
  - Source of bytes: file chooser (`launchAsync`, message thread, SafePointer, no `complete()` inside the callback) or drag-and-drop (macOS `webkitGetAsEntry` pattern, base64 over the bridge, chunked ≤ 1 MB per call; Windows `dataTransfer.files`).
  - Missing source on load → library fallback (Sine Product) + localised notice (QUAL-03).

### 9. Voice integration (StrataVoice changes)
- **JUCE Class:** existing `StrataVoice` (`juce::SynthesiserVoice`), `juce::SmoothedValue<float>` per smoothed base value, existing `ModulationMatrix` (`dsp/ModulationMatrix.h`)
- **Purpose:** FUNC-05 (10 new destinations per oscillator, per-sample), QUAL-02 (no zipper), DSP-01 (pitch tracking needs the note frequency).
- **Parameters Affected:** the 22 modulated base values (11 per osc: Pos + 10 new), `modSlot{0..15}Dst`
- **Configuration:**
  - **`ModDest` enum / `getModDestNames()` (`ModulationMatrix.h:52-101`):** the 26 existing entries keep their indices; entries 1–2 are relabelled `"OscA Size"` / `"OscB Size"` (enum names `OscAPos` / `OscBPos` stay — same index, minimal diff). Appended after `OscBWarpAmt`, in parameter-spec order, A then B: `OscAAspect, OscARot, OscACtrX, OscACtrY, OscAOrbMod, OscATerFreq, OscATerModX, OscATerModY, OscAFeedback, OscASat, OscBAspect, … OscBSat` → `NumDests = 46`. Strings (host-visible, O-Prism's short style): `"OscA Aspect", "OscA Rot", "OscA CtrX", "OscA CtrY", "OscA OrbMod", "OscA TerFreq", "OscA TerModX", "OscA TerModY", "OscA Fdbk", "OscA Sat"` and the OscB set. The `modSlot?Dst` `AudioParameterChoice` picks the list up automatically (`PluginProcessor.cpp:469-482`); choice lists are append-only from v1.0.0.
  - **Offset → parameter mapping (per sample, in the existing "Apply modulation offsets" section, `StrataVoice.cpp:570-586`):** Size/Aspect/Orbit Mod/Mod X/Mod Y/Feedback/Saturation: additive, clamped to the parameter range (Aspect offset × 0.9); Rotation: offset × 180°; Centre X/Y: additive, clamped [−1, 1]; Terrain Freq: log-domain ±2 octaves, F = base · 2^(2·offset), clamped [0.25, 8] (Bandlimited: [0.25, 2]). Same conventions as O-Prism's Pos (additive, clamped) and LFO rate (±2 octaves).
  - **Smoothing (QUAL-02):** the voice holds one `juce::SmoothedValue<float>` per modulated base value (22 per voice), `reset(fs, 0.005)` in `prepare`, `setTargetValue(apvts)` once per block, `getNextValue()` per sample, then `+ modOffset` → setter. This is O-Prism's exact per-sample call pattern with the stepped APVTS read replaced by a ramp; stepping any destination by 10 % every 100 ms produces a 5 ms ramp (gate H5). ModWheel and Aftertouch (7-bit steps) get a per-voice `SmoothedValue` (5 ms) before `setSourceValue` — two extra ramps per voice make every destination CC-step-safe. Cost ≈ 24 ramps × ≈ 1 ns per voice-sample ≈ 1.8 % at 16 voices (in the PERF-02 model).
  - **Block-rate feed to the oscillator (`updateBlockRate`):** note frequency after glide target (for pitch tracking; the per-sample glide / pitch-mod ratio is ≤ ±1 semitone within a 10 ms block and does not need per-sample tracking), Pitch Track, Feedback Damp, Terrain / Orbit / Quality enums, Edge Mode, the published `TerrainImage*` and `ChebyshevSet*`.
  - FM cross-feed, pan, level, mix and everything after the oscillators are unchanged (`StrataVoice.cpp:588-745`).

### 10. CycleCapture (view data for the ≋ waveform and the feedback trail)
- **JUCE Class:** Custom lock-free ring per oscillator (`std::array<float, 2048 × 3>` for y, x, y-coordinates + `std::atomic<uint32_t>` write index), written by the display voice (most recently triggered, as O-Prism's held-note tracking) on the audio thread, read at 30 Hz by the editor timer.
- **Purpose:** UI-01 (scan point + feedback trail), the Synth-tab ≋ view; replaces `getActiveOscFrame` / `getActiveOscInfo` (`PluginEditor.cpp:492-524`), which read a wavetable frame that no longer exists.
- **Configuration:** the display voice's partial 0 writes (θ, p_x, p_y, y) per base sample — the *displaced* point p, so the trail is the actual trajectory (BRIEF UI). The editor decimates to 512 points and pushes `terrainCycle` (base64 Float32 ≈ 8 KB) only when the ≋ view or a Feedback > 0 trail is visible; `terrainPlayhead` `{osc, theta, x, y}` at 30 Hz, change-gated, via `emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible`. The 64 × 64 heightmap of the current terrain (analytic evaluated on the message thread, ≈ 0.1 ms; image decimated in the import job) is pushed on terrain / Mod X / Mod Y / Freq change at ≤ 10 Hz.

## Processing Chain

Per voice, per base sample (the voice loop, `StrataVoice::renderNextBlock`, is O-Prism's; only the oscillator box is new):

```
MIDI note → TuningEngine → glide → f_note ─────────────────────────────────────┐
                                                                              │ block-rate
APVTS base values ──► SmoothedValue (5 ms) ──┐                                 │ updateBlockRate():
LFO1-4 / envelopes / velocity / note ────────┤ per-sample                      │  r_track = min(1, f_ref/f_note)^track
ModWheel / Aftertouch (smoothed 5 ms) ───────┤ ModulationMatrix.evaluate()     │  a_eff (damp), D_max (Chebyshev)
                                             ▼                                 │  enums, image*, cheb*
                     11 setters per osc (Size, Aspect, Rot, CtrX/Y, OrbMod,     │
                     TerFreq, TerModX/Y, Feedback, Sat) + FM input + frequency  │
                                             │                                 │
   ┌─────────────────────── TerrainOscillator (A, then B) ──────────────────────┴───────────────────────┐
   │  for each unison partial i (≤ 4):                                                                   │
   │    for s in 0..OS−1  (OS = 1 Bandlimited | 2 | 4):                                                  │
   │      phase_i += inc/OS · detune_i ;  θ = 2π · applyWarp(phase_i)   [Sync/Bend/FM/Window unchanged]  │
   │      b = OrbitLibrary[orbit](θ, m) → aspect → rotate ρ → · r → + c                                   │
   │      p = clamp(b + fb · d_i · û, [−1,1]²)                          [TrajectoryFeedback]              │
   │      y = clamp( Terrain(p) , −1, 1)                                                                  │
   │          Terrain = analytic[terrain](F_eff, mx, my) | bilinear(image, blur, edge) | Clenshaw(cheb, D_max) │
   │      d_i = a_eff·d_i + (1−a_eff)·½(y1_i + y2_i); clamp ±0.5; y2_i = y1_i; y1_i = y                  │
   │      y = sat > 0 ? fastTanh(g·y)/fastTanh(g) : y                    [Saturation, identity at 0]       │
   │      sub[s] = y                                                                                      │
   │    out_i = HalfbandDecimator_i(sub[0..OS−1])      (OS = 1: out_i = sub[0])                            │
   │    L += out_i · gain · panL_i ;  R += out_i · gain · panR_i                                           │
   │  L, R → DC blocker (5 Hz)  → (oscAL, oscAR)                                                          │
   │  CycleCapture ← (θ, p, y) of partial 0 (display voice only)                                          │
   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                             │
   lastOscAOut / lastOscBOut (FM cross-feed, next sample) ◄──┘
                                             ▼
   pan → level → Osc Mix → noise → sub → dual SVF (serial/parallel) → amp env × velocity   [inherited]
                                             ▼
   voice sum → FX rack (dist → chorus → delay → reverb → EQ) → master / width               [inherited]
```

**Routing notes:**
- Everything outside the oscillator box runs at base rate (DSP-03); the oversampling factor applies to the scan only.
- The FM warp uses the other oscillator's previous *base-rate* output, held over the sub-samples — parity with O-Prism's per-sample cross-feed.
- Quality is per oscillator: A may be Bandlimited while B runs at 4×.
- Bandlimited mode replaces the "Terrain" box with the Clenshaw evaluator and sets OS = 1; the orbit / feedback / saturation boxes are identical.
- Feedback loop: strictly per partial, one-sample delayed, bounded (Core 4). No cross-partial or cross-oscillator feedback.

## System Architecture

### File I/O System

**File types supported:** PNG (8/16-bit greyscale or RGB → luminance), via `juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom` (juce_graphics). Scala / KBM import inherited (O-Prism ARCHITECTURE "File I/O System").

**Loading strategy:** background import job (`juce::ThreadPool`, shared with the ChebyshevScheduler) — decode, downsample to ≤ 1024², luminance, pre-blur, Chebyshev projection, 64 × 64 view heightmap; publish through `imagePtr[osc]` on the message thread via `callAsync`.

**Thread safety:** file chooser on the message thread (`launchAsync` + SafePointer); drag-and-drop bytes arrive as base64 chunks through a native function, assembled on the message thread; the job copies the bytes; the audio thread reads only the published pointer. Never blocks on I/O.

**Error handling:** undecodable file → notice, previous terrain kept; > 16 MB file → rejected with notice; missing file on restore → library fallback + notice (QUAL-03).

### Multi-Output Routing
Not applicable — stereo output synth, `BusesProperties` unchanged from O-Prism (constructor, not `prepareToPlay`).

### MIDI Routing
Inherited (O-Prism ARCHITECTURE "MIDI Routing": note on/off, pitch bend through TuningEngine, CC1 / aftertouch to processor atomics, VST3 note expression).

### State Persistence

Reuses superseded "State Persistence" and "Decision 1" verbatim with these substitutions:
- Child `terrainImports` (the Stage 1 fork wrote an empty `geometryImports`, `PluginProcessor.cpp:1081, 1129` — renamed in the Stage 1 second pass) → `<oscAImport kind="png" name="…" sha256="…" bytes="…" embedded="1" data="<base64>"/>` or `embedded="0" path="…" sha256="…" name="…"`.
- **Cap 2 MB per oscillator, raw PNG bytes, no gzip** (already deflated). Above the cap: path + SHA-256 + name.
- Non-parameter properties are strings on round-trip (`isVoid()` / `toString()`, memory `critical_valuetree_xml_roundtrip_loses_type`).
- Preset files: preset-manager `customSave` / `customLoad` carry the `terrainImports` tree; the choice-param migration hook covers future list changes.
- **Not saved:** Chebyshev sets (regenerated), decoded / blurred images (regenerated from bytes), view caches.
- Restore: `setStateInformation` stores the blob under `importLock` (message/host threads only) and bumps `imageGeneration[osc]`; the import job regenerates on the message-thread timer. Identical bytes ⇒ identical render (FUNC-08 acceptance: SHA-256 of a 1 s render matches).
- **Parameter migration on the fork:** no O-Strata preset has shipped, so the Stage 1 second pass changes `osc?Pos` default and `osc?Unison` range without a migration gate. From v1.0.0 on, each range change needs its own gate (memory `pattern_preset_migration_per_param_version_gate`).

### 3D Terrain View (Stage 3; data path starts in the processor)

As superseded "3D Geometry View", terrain branch only: displaced 64 × 64 wireframe + orbit polyline (512 points, computed in JS from the orbit parameters — the same formulas as Core 2, ported to JS with a golden check against a C++ dump) + scan point + feedback trail (from `terrainCycle`, Core 10). Events: `terrainPlayhead` (30 Hz, change-gated), `terrainHeightmap` (≤ 10 Hz on change, base64 Float32 16 KB), `terrainCycle` (30 Hz while visible), `terrainStatus` (readout: quality, partials at C4, fit %, exact/approximate, source-missing). All via `emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible`; re-pushed after preset apply / `setStateInformation` (`chebGeneration` / `imageGeneration` change) (UI-04). Interaction → APVTS through `Juce.getSliderState` with drag-start / drag-end (UI-03); relays exist because every new float ID is in `allSliderIds()`.

## Algorithm Details

### Pitch-tracked terrain frequency ("terrain mip", DSP-01)

**Law (per voice, per block, Core 9 → Core 1):**
F_eff = F_mod · r_track,  r_track = min(1, f_ref / f_note)^track,  f_ref = 261.63 Hz (C4), track = Pitch Track.
F_mod = clamp(F_base · 2^(2·modOffset), 0.25, 8) is the per-sample modulated value; r_track is block-rate (one `pow` per oscillator per block). f_note = the voice's glide *target* frequency (`glide.setTarget`, `StrataVoice.cpp`), not the per-sample glided value, and not the unison-detuned partial frequency (≤ 50 cents, irrelevant).

**Why a hard knee at C4, scaling only downward:** the harmonic count of a sine-product terrain is not proportional to F at low F (it is dominated by the orbit geometry: F = 0.5 → 4 partials, F = 1 → 5, F = 2 → 9, F = 4 → 11, F = 8 → 21 above −40 dB at r = 0.5) — scaling F *up* below C4 would change the patch's character and fail DSP-01's "differs by ≤ 2" at C2. With the knee: C2 = C4 = 5 partials, C6 (F_eff = 0.25) ≈ 4 → passes; and at the top the spatial frequency falls as 1/f exactly like a mip. §7.2's finding (unbounded spatial frequency aliases at +16 dB at 1× and is not fixable by oversampling alone) is addressed because the top octaves see F_eff ≤ F/4.

**Composition with Bandlimited mode:** r_track is not applied (Pitch Track inert) — the coefficient set is pitch-invariant and the truncation D_max(f_note, K) is the mip (Core 6). The UI states this on the Terrain tab.

**Harness (H4):** Pitch Track 1: partials above −40 dB at C2 / C4 / C6 differ by ≤ 2 at F = 1 and at F = 4; negative control: Pitch Track 0 at **F = 8** (at F = 1 the default patch never reaches Nyquist, so a negative control at defaults would be vacuous — memory `pattern_probe_must_target_the_branch_the_fix_changed`), C6, 2×: non-harmonic energy rises by ≥ 20 dB versus Pitch Track 1.

### Trajectory feedback (FUNC-04)
See Core 4 for the recurrence, the two-sample average, the damp law and the boundedness argument. Per-partial state: `d`, `y1`, `y2` (3 floats). Reset at note-on (`startNote` → `reset()` / `resetWithPhase`). Per-sub-sample at 2× / 4×, damp coefficient rate-corrected.

**Harness (H3):** grid Feedback ∈ {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1} × Damp ∈ {0, 0.5, 1} × 6 terrains × 11 orbits × {C2, C4, C6} × {2×} (2376 renders × 0.5 s ≈ 20 s): every sample finite, |y| ≤ 1 at the oscillator output, |DC| of the post-blocker output < 1e-3 over the last 250 ms; plus Feedback = 0 versus a harness-only `feedbackPathEnabled = false` switch on the same 66 terrain × orbit pairs: `memcmp` equal (bit-identical). The switch is a harness flag, not a parameter (memory: negative controls must hit the branch).

### Bandlimited mode — Chebyshev projection (DSP-02)

**Analytic terrains (ChebyshevProjector, background job):** Chebyshev–Gauss quadrature with M nodes per axis, x_i = cos(π(i + ½)/M), M = max(32, 8·⌈2F⌉ + 16) (M = 32 at F ≤ 1, 48 at F = 2 — enough that the quadrature does not alias the terrain);
c_nm = (2/M)² · w_n w_m · Σ_i Σ_j f(x_i, x_j) T_n(x_i) T_m(x_j), w_0 = ½, else 1; computed separably (G_nj = Σ_i T_n(x_i) f(x_i, x_j), then c_nm = Σ_j G_nj T_m(x_j)): M² terrain evaluations (≈ 30 ns each) + 2·17·M² multiplies → ≈ 0.1 ms at M = 32, ≈ 0.3 ms at M = 48. Coefficients with n + m > 16 discarded; the fit metric ‖f − Pf‖² / ‖f‖² on the quadrature grid is stored with the set for the readout. Precision: `double` accumulation, `float` storage.

**Measured fits (degree-16 triangle, πF convention, Stage 0):** Sine Product 100 % up to F = 2, 24 % at F = 4; Radial Rings 100 / 94 % (F = 1 / 2); Saddle 100 / 99.9 %; Ridged Cosines 99.5 / 96.8 %; Mitsuhashi 100 % at every F (polynomial); Cosine Wells 98 / 76 %. Hence the clamp F ≤ 2 in this mode.

**Trig-polynomial bound:** with x(θ), y(θ) of degree K, T_n(x(θ)) T_m(y(θ)) has degree ≤ (n + m)·K (products of trig polynomials add degrees), so harmonic index ≤ (n + m)_max · K. Ellipse / centre / aspect / rotation are affine in (cos θ, sin θ) → K unchanged (verified §7.2: ellipse 0.8 + offset 0.1 → max harmonic 16, −117 dB floor).

**Per-pitch truncation:** Core 6. Bound uses 0.5·fs strictly (no oversampling in this mode, so the top harmonic must sit below Nyquist, and with the 2-diagonal taper the last diagonal is already attenuated).

**Per-sample evaluation:** 2-D Clenshaw over the triangle at p (after feedback displacement and centre offset — p is just a point; the bound only depends on the orbit being a trig polynomial, which feedback breaks → "approximate" readout when fb > 0). Cost ≤ 57 ns (full 16 × 16 tensor measured, §7.2) → PERF model uses 57 ns as the ceiling, ≈ 35 ns expected for the triangle.

**Swap cadence:** Core 7 — 50 ms poll, 50 ms debounce, ≤ 20 Hz publish, one-block crossfade in the oscillator.

### PNG → Chebyshev projection at import ("bandlimited image")

Same triangle, computed from the pre-blurred image (after Edge Mode is applied as a function on [−1, 1]²): sample the edge-extended, blurred image at the M = 64 Chebyshev–Gauss node grid **after** an additional low-pass matched to the node spacing (a box filter of W/64 px, so the quadrature sees a band-limited version — otherwise the 64² nodes alias pixel detail), then the separable contraction: 64² bilinear reads + 2·17·64² multiplies ≈ 0.3 ms. Runs inside the import job once per (bytes, blur, edge) — F scaling is not projected (the image is projected at F = 1; in Bandlimited mode `Imported…` ignores Terrain Freq and the readout says "image projected at F = 1"). Stored with the `TerrainImage`. The readout shows the fit % of the image (typically 60–90 % for a photograph, ≥ 95 % for a smooth gradient) so the user knows how much of the picture survives the bandlimit.

### Halfband decimator design
Core 5. Coefficients via `FilterDesign<float>::designIIRLowpassHalfBandPolyphaseAllpassMethod(0.06, −70)` for the 2× stage and `(0.15, −60)` for the 4×→2× stage, in `prepare`; per-sample allpass sections `y = a·(x − y2) + x2` (`kernels.h` `Halfband2x::AP`). Verified numerically: the two paths' DC group delays agree to 0.003 sub-samples (2.293 vs 2.296), i.e. the polyphase structure is balanced.

### Symmetry rule (DSP-06)
A centred orbit over a centrosymmetric (even) terrain repeats every half-turn: f(−p) = f(p) and b(θ + π) = −b(θ) ⇒ y(θ + π) = y(θ) ⇒ period halves ⇒ octave up (Sine Product, Rings, Saddle, Ridged, Wells at defaults). Over an odd terrain (Mitsuhashi) y(θ + π) = −y(θ) ⇒ odd harmonics only (right pitch, hollow). A p-fold symmetric orbit (epitrochoid / hypocycloid centred) over a matching field plays a p-th. Defaults c = (0.13, 0.21), aspect 0.7, r = 0.5, F = 1: h1 = 0 dB (strongest), 5 partials.

**Harness (H2):** for every terrain × orbit at defaults and every factory preset (loaded through `FactoryPresets::build`): 1 s at C4, Hann 8192-point windows hopped 100 ms: pass if h1 ≥ (strongest partial − 6 dB) in ≥ 95 % of windows. Negative control: Sine Product + Ellipse, Centre (0, 0), Aspect 1 → h1 absent (period halves) → fails. Note (Stage 0 sweep): the gate is **not monotone in F** — at c = (0.13, 0.21), r = 0.5, F = 2 gives h1 = −46 dB and F = 4 gives −8.6 dB (Bessel-type cancellations), so every factory preset must be gated individually; presets that fail are fixed by moving the centre (the harness prints h1 for the eight neighbouring centres ±0.1).

### CPU budget model (PERF-02)

Per partial per **base** sample at 48 kHz, M4 Max numbers from §7.2 unless marked (est.):

| Term | Default patch (Sine Product + Ellipse, 2×, Sat 0) | Bandlimited (1×) | Worst 2× (Ridged/Rings + Butterfly, Sat > 0) |
|------|------------------------------------------------|------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| orbit + terrain per sub-sample | 12 + 22 = 34 (tanh skipped) | 12 + 57 = 69 | 20 + 38 + 8 = 66 |
| feedback + clamps per sub-sample (est.) | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| × OS | × 2 = 78 | × 1 = 74 | × 2 = 142 |
| decimator | 9 | 0 | 9 |
| DC blocker, smoothing share per partial (est.; 24 ramps per voice ÷ 2 osc) | 2 + 12 = 14 | 14 | 14 |
| **per partial** | **≈ 101 ns** | ≈ 88 ns | ≈ 165 ns |
| 16 voices × 2 osc × unison 1 (1.536 M partial-samples/s) | **≈ 15.5 %** | ≈ 13.5 % | ≈ 25 % |
| unison 4 | ≈ 62 % | ≈ 54 % | ≈ 100 % |

**Reading:** §7.2's 8.8 % is the kernel-only figure (epitrochoid-7 + sine product at 2×, no decimator, no smoothing, no feedback). The full-path model lands at **≈ 15 % for the oscillator delta** at the default patch, and the inherited voice loop (4 LFOs, 16-slot matrix, 4 SVFs, envelopes, FX) is on top of that. This is over the 12 % that PERF-02 quotes for a whole-plugin wall-time measurement. Consequences (Decision 11): (a) the gate is implemented as **oscillator delta ≤ 12 %** — the harness measures the default patch twice, once normally and once with a harness-only `terrainKernelBypass` switch (the scan returns 0 and skips the decimator, the rest of the voice loop unchanged) and reports total, baseline and delta; (b) two concrete savings are planned in Phase 2.3 before the gate runs: **share the SmoothedValue ramps per oscillator, not per voice** (the base values are identical across voices: 22 ramps in the processor read by all voices → −12 ns per partial), and **skip the feedback update when fb = 0 on the whole block** (−5 ns × 2) → ≈ 74 ns ≈ 11.4 %; (c) if the delta still exceeds 12 %, the fallback is a float (not double) phase path for the terrain branch (the wavetable path is double for table indexing precision; the terrain path needs only float θ — the bench kernels are float). REQUIREMENTS PERF-02 wording should be amended to "oscillator delta" (open question for Taylor, ROADMAP Stage 2 entry).

## Integration Points

### Feature Dependencies
```
OrbitLibrary ──┐
TerrainLibrary ┼──► TerrainOscillator ◄── TrajectoryFeedback (per partial)
TerrainImage ──┤         │  ▲
ChebyshevSet ──┘         │  │ HalfbandDecimator (per partial, OS 2/4)
                         ▼
                 StrataVoice (mod destinations, smoothing, block-rate feed)  ◄── ModulationMatrix, LFOs, envelopes, TuningEngine, Glide (inherited)
                         ▼
                 inherited filters / FX / master
ChebyshevScheduler ──► chebPtr[osc]  (message → audio)     TerrainImport job ──► imagePtr[osc]
CycleCapture ──► editor timer ──► WebView events            State (terrainImports) ──► import job
```

### Parameter Interactions
- Orbit Size × Terrain Freq: both raise harmonic count (phase excursion ∝ F·r); the harness's centroid-monotonicity check (FUNC-03 acceptance) is on Size at F = 1.
- Centre + Feedback: feedback drifts the effective centre by up to 0.5 (clamped); the trail shows it.
- Quality × Terrain Freq: Bandlimited clamps F to ≤ 2 and ignores Pitch Track; the readout explains.
- Quality × Orbit: Bandlimited is exact only for K-orbits; the readout says "approximate" for Superellipse / Butterfly / Squarcle and whenever Feedback > 0.
- Quality × mod matrix: in Bandlimited mode the three terrain destinations are block-rate (global sources) / bypassed (per-voice sources).
- Unison: capped at 4 for both oscillators (the parameter range changes; O-Prism stays at 8).
- Blur / Edge inert unless Terrain = Imported… (UI greys them; the key ignores them otherwise).
- Warp FM: parity with O-Prism (previous base-rate sample of the other oscillator into the phase).

### Processing Order Requirements
1. Block start: `updateOscillatorAssignments()` (publish pickup) → voice `updateBlockRate` (frequency, tracking, damp, D_max, enums, pointers) → SmoothedValue targets.
2. Per sample: envelopes → glide → mod sources → `modMatrix.evaluate()` → smoothed base + offsets → setters → `oscA.getNextSampleStereo` → `oscB` (FM cross-feed uses the previous sample) → pan / level / mix → noise / sub → filters → env.
3. Inside the oscillator: phase advance → warp → orbit → feedback displacement → clamp → terrain → clamp → feedback state update → saturation → decimate → DC blocker.
4. Chebyshev crossfade happens in the block where the pointer changed; the reaper frees the old set ≥ 2 generations later.

### Thread Boundaries
Superseded "Thread Boundaries" applies, with these changes:
- **Audio thread** now owns real DSP (Core 1–6 evaluation). It never: allocates, locks, designs filters, projects coefficients, decodes images, or touches the WebView. It reads `chebPtr` / `imagePtr` with `load(acquire)` once per block and `blockGeneration.fetch_add(release)` at block end (existing, `PluginProcessor.cpp:970`).
- **Message thread:** ChebyshevScheduler timer (50 ms), import assembly, publish (`callAsync` targets), reaper timer (500 ms, existing), editor timer (30 Hz) pushes, `setLatencySamples` follow-up (existing pattern), state save / restore (lock-guarded import blob + generation bump only).
- **Background ("O-Strata Chebyshev" / import, `juce::ThreadPool`, 1–2 threads):** projection, decode, blur, heightmap. Never writes APVTS, pointers, or the WebView.
- **Communication:** APVTS atomics (host/UI → audio, block-rate); `std::atomic<const ChebyshevSet*> chebPtr[2]`, `std::atomic<const TerrainImage*> imagePtr[2]` (message → audio, release/acquire); `retired` + `blockGeneration` (audio → message, generation-counted reaper, now type-erased); `std::atomic<int> chebGeneration[2], imageGeneration[2]`, `std::atomic<float> chebFit[2]` (message/background → editor); `CycleCapture` ring (audio → editor, single-writer / single-reader, index atomic); `importLock` (`juce::CriticalSection`, message/host/background only).
- **Safety guarantees:** the audio thread never waits (PERF-01); a set or image is never freed while any voice can read it (two-generation reaper, also covers the one-block crossfade); publish is message-thread only; `prepareToPlay` publishes nothing; `FilterDesign` only in `prepare`; the Quality switch is an enum flip over pre-allocated state.

## Implementation Risks

### Aliasing at 2× on high-lobe orbits (QUAL-01)
- **Risk:** §7.2 measured epitrochoid-7 + sine product at **−18 dB at 2×** (no pitch tracking, 2πF convention). QUAL-01 wants ≤ −60 dB at C6 for every library pair at defaults with Pitch Track 1.
- **Likelihood:** MEDIUM. Mitigations already in the design: πF convention (half the spatial frequency of the bench case), pitch tracking (F_eff = 0.25 at C6), Orbit Mod default 0.5 (d = 1.55 for epitrochoids — moderate lobes), r = 0.5.
- **Fallback (in order):** (1) lower the epitrochoid / hypocycloid d-range so the default lobes are shallower; (2) make the *default* Quality per orbit — 4× auto-selected for K ≥ 6 (an "Auto" fourth Quality entry, append-only); (3) a per-voice harmonic-budget clamp on F_eff: h_est = K·(πF·r + 3) ≤ 0.45·fs / f_note (block-rate, conservative, documented in the readout).
- **Gate:** Harness H6 in Phase 2.3.

### CPU over the 12 % line (PERF-02)
- **Risk:** the full-path model says ≈ 15 % oscillator delta at the default patch vs 12 %.
- **Likelihood:** HIGH that the first measurement is over; MEDIUM that it stays over after the two planned savings (shared ramps, fb = 0 skip) → ≈ 11.4 %.
- **Fallback:** float terrain phase path; drop the per-partial DC blocker to per-oscillator (already the design); reduce SmoothedValue count by smoothing only the destinations that are actually routed or automated (a "dirty" flag per parameter, 1 compare per block). Last resort: raise the gate to 15 % with Taylor's sign-off and document.
- **Gate:** Harness H7 (delta measurement) in Phase 2.3.

### Bandlimited mode is narrower than the brief implies
- **Risk:** Terrain Freq clamped ≤ 2, Pitch Track inert, per-voice terrain modulation bypassed, high-K orbits dull at the top. Users may read "Bandlimited" as "the same sound, alias-free".
- **Likelihood:** HIGH that some expectation mismatch shows up in the listening pass.
- **Mitigation:** the Terrain-tab readout states exactly what the mode does (partials at C4, fit %, exact / approximate, "terrain mod 20 Hz"); factory presets showcase it where it shines (Cosine Wells + Hypocycloid 3 bell, Mitsuhashi + Ellipse organ). **Fallback / v1.1:** the F-lattice (13 coefficient sets over F ∈ [0.25, 2] at ¼-octave, per-voice block-rate lerp — a blend of two bandlimited signals is bandlimited) restores Terrain Freq as a live per-voice destination; degree-24 sets (325 coefficients, ≈ 2.2× Clenshaw cost) would push the F clamp to ≈ 3.

### Feedback character vs stability
- **Risk:** the two-sample average + one-pole makes Damp 0 safe but may sound tamer than *Terrain*'s raw feedback.
- **Likelihood:** LOW–MEDIUM (BRIEF Next Step 1: listen to *Terrain* first).
- **Fallback:** expose the averaging as part of the Damp law (Damp < 0.1 → blend toward single-sample) only if the listening pass asks; boundedness does not depend on it (clamps do the work); the H3 grid re-runs.

### Chebyshev swap artefacts under fast terrain automation
- **Risk:** 20 Hz swaps with one-block crossfades on a continuously automated Mod X sound stepped.
- **Likelihood:** MEDIUM for LFO-style automation of terrain params in Bandlimited mode (by design block-rate; 2×/4× modes are per-sample and unaffected).
- **Fallback:** crossfade over 4 blocks; the F-lattice for Freq; keep the mode's terrain params "set and forget" in the docs.

### Pitch-track knee and the reference pitch
- **Risk:** the hard knee at C4 is a slope corner in a per-note function; a bright patch played chromatically across C4 may show a brightness step of ≈ 1 semitone of tracking.
- **Likelihood:** LOW (per-note; with glide the block-rate update already ramps).
- **Fallback:** soft knee r = (1 + (f/f_ref)²)^(−track/2) with f_ref = 370 Hz (keeps r(C4) ≈ 0.93); constant, no parameter.

### 3D view in WKWebView / WebView2, PNG persistence, missing source
As superseded "3D view in WKWebView / WebView2" and "Preset with a missing imported source" — unchanged risk profile (MEDIUM / LOW), same fallbacks.

### Overall Project Risk
**Overall complexity:** HIGH — a new audio-thread component with three evaluation paths (analytic, image, Chebyshev), per-partial oversampling and feedback, on the largest engine in the catalogue, with 3 harness-gated quality requirements. **Highest-risk components:** the CPU/aliasing pair at 2× (PERF-02 / QUAL-01) — ≈ 50 % of the risk — then Bandlimited-mode expectations. **Recommended approach:** build the 1× analytic oscillator first with the harness beside it (Phase 2.1), prove θ parity and the symmetry gate, then feedback + tracking (2.2), then oversampling with the CPU and aliasing gates (2.3), then Bandlimited (2.4), then images (2.5) — each phase adds one evaluation path to a proven loop.

## Architecture Decisions

### Decision 1: Trajectory feedback = leaky integrator on a two-sample average, clamped, no DC blocker on the displacement
**Decision:** Core 4 recurrence with a = 1 − 2^(−1 − 9·Damp), rate/OS-corrected, `d` clamped ±0.5, `p` clamped to the domain, `y` clamped to [−1, 1], `d` NaN-scrubbed and reset at note-on; the output gets a 5 Hz DC blocker. **Rationale:** boundedness follows from the clamps alone (worst-case gain 1); the two-sample average removes the Nyquist hunting mode that single-sample self-feedback exhibits (DX7 precedent); the displacement's DC is the intended spatial compression. **Alternatives:** raw single-sample feedback (hunts at Damp 0); feedback into θ instead of position (that is FM, already a warp). **Tradeoff:** slightly tamer than raw feedback at Damp 0.

### Decision 2: Pitch tracking = F_eff = F · min(1, f_ref/f_note)^track, f_ref = C4, block-rate
**Rationale:** keeps the harmonic count of a patch bounded above C4 (the aliasing octaves) without changing its character below C4 (DSP-01 acceptance at C2/C4/C6); one `pow` per block. **Alternatives:** scale in both directions (fails DSP-01 at C2, dulls/brightens the patch across the keyboard); per-sample tracking (a `pow` per sample for no audible gain); soft knee (kept as fallback).

### Decision 3: Bandlimited mode = degree-16 triangle, F clamped ≤ 2, Pitch Track inert, truncation is the mip; terrain mod destinations block-rate (global) / bypassed (per-voice)
**Rationale:** the degree-16 fit is ≥ 94 % up to F = 2 under the πF convention and collapses beyond; the coefficient set is shared across voices, so per-voice per-sample terrain modulation cannot exist in this mode without per-voice sets; Terrain Freq via a lattice is the clean v1.1 extension. **Alternatives:** degree 24 (2.2× cost, F ≈ 3); per-voice sets (0.1 ms × 32 per block on the audio thread — no); F-lattice now (v1.1 — deferred to keep Phase 2.4 bounded).

### Decision 4: PNG → Chebyshev at import, node-matched low-pass before quadrature, projected at F = 1 only
**Rationale:** 0.3 ms per image; the anti-alias box filter makes the 64² quadrature honest; F-scaling an image projection would need a lattice for no clear musical gain. **Alternative:** full-resolution tensor contraction (5 ms per image — fine, but the low-pass is still needed; the node grid is simpler).

### Decision 5: Hand-rolled per-sample polyphase-IIR decimator with JUCE-designed coefficients; constant 1-sample latency report
**Rationale:** the oscillator synthesises at OS·fs (no upsampler needed); `juce::dsp::Oversampling` is block-only and would break the per-sample FM cross-feed and mod destinations; the decimator costs 9 ns; latency 1.15 (2×) / ≈ 1.4 (4×) / 0 base samples differs per oscillator and per voice when Quality is automated, so per-path reporting is impossible — a constant `+1` sample on top of the distortion latency is honest to within 0.4 sample. **Alternatives:** `juce::dsp::Oversampling` on the whole voice (must-have 2 forbids: +10–15 % of a core and every filter re-prepared at 2·fs); FIR half-band (linear phase, ≈ 4× the cost); delay-aligning all paths to 2 samples (fractional delay per partial for 0.4 sample of skew — not worth 3 ns).

### Decision 6: Delete `WavetableOscillator` / `WavetableData` / `WavetableGenerator` and the table plumbing in Phase 2.1; generalise the reaper
**Decision:** `TerrainOscillator` replaces `WavetableOscillator` **in place** (same member names in `StrataVoice`, same call sites); the wavetable classes, `oscTablePtr[]`, the sine placeholder, `getActiveOscTable/Info/Frame` are removed; `retireTable` becomes `retire(std::unique_ptr<Retirable>)` used by `ChebyshevSet` and `TerrainImage`. **Rationale:** (a) BRIEF: "Wavetable oscillator mode: none"; (b) dormant code in a repo with no unit tests and no CI tests rots silently, and O-Prism's copy keeps evolving — a v1.1 Baked source would re-fork from O-Prism's then-current sources and `superseded-baked-v1/` anyway; (c) −750 lines to maintain; (d) the reaper generalisation is needed regardless. **Alternative:** keep behind a `Source` switch — rejected (superseded Decision 5 reasoning). **Sequencing:** the sine placeholder stays through the Stage 1 second pass so pluginval / auval validate a sounding plugin; it goes when Phase 2.1 lands.

### Decision 7: Mod destinations appended (46), relabel at index 1/2, per-voice `SmoothedValue` on base values, log-domain Terrain Freq mod
**Rationale:** append-only keeps every O-Prism preset index valid; smoothing the *base* value with the raw per-sample offset added keeps O-Prism's call pattern and fixes stepped host automation; ModWheel / Aftertouch smoothing fixes stepped CC. **Alternative:** smoothing inside the oscillator with a per-sample-moving target (a division per sample per param — no).

### Decision 8: Quality default = 2×
**Rationale:** CPU parity with Bandlimited (≈ 101 vs 88 ns per partial); identical behaviour for all 11 orbits and PNGs; live per-sample terrain modulation; QUAL-01's −60 dB at C6 is the gate for it. Bandlimited is the showcase (≥ 3 factory presets), not the default, because it narrows Terrain Freq, freezes Pitch Track and block-rates terrain modulation. **Alternative:** Bandlimited default — rejected for the expectation mismatch listed under Risks.

### Decision 9: Symmetry defaults c = (0.13, 0.21), aspect 0.7, r = 0.5, F = 1 under the πF convention; per-preset gate
**Rationale:** measured h1 = 0 dB, 5 partials; the same centre fails at F = 2 (−46 dB), so the gate runs per preset, not per default. **Alternative:** enforce asymmetry structurally (e.g. add a fixed offset to every orbit) — rejected: users must be able to centre an orbit on purpose (Mitsuhashi centred = odd-harmonic organ).

### Decision 10: Clean-room libraries — 6 terrains, 11 orbits, πF convention, `pow`-free
**Rationale:** formulas re-derived from the mathematics (Mitsuhashi 1982 / Mills & de Souza 1999 / standard curve definitions), attribution to *Terrain* as inspiration only (GPL-3.0 vs AGPL-3.0); the Butterfly's sin⁵(θ/12) term replaced by a 2π-periodic wing term so the orbit closes once per cycle; Superellipse via LUT; Cosine Wells' fractional power via integer-power lerp. **Alternative:** ship *Terrain*'s exact formula set — rejected on licence and on closure (several of its curves are not 2π-periodic).

### Decision 11: PERF-02 measured as oscillator delta, with two planned savings before the gate
See "CPU budget model". **Open question for Taylor:** amend PERF-02's wording from "≤ 12 % of one core" to "oscillator delta ≤ 12 %" (the whole-plugin number includes the inherited engine, which the brief's 8.8 % never counted).

### Decision 12: Stage-2 harness = O-Bowed-style `tests/render-harness/` console target + the Stage 1 smoke pattern
See "Harness design (Stage 2)".

## Special Considerations

### Thread Safety
- All parameter reads via cached `getRawParameterValue()` atomics (existing pattern, `StrataVoice.cpp:42-75`).
- Pointer publish / retire only on the message thread; audio thread `load(acquire)` per block; reaper frees ≥ 2 generations later.
- `CycleCapture` is single-writer (display voice) / single-reader (editor); a voice-steal that changes the display voice is handled by the processor's existing "most recently triggered" tracking.
- `FilterDesign` and the Superellipse LUT build are `prepare`-only.

### Performance
- Per-sample path: `switch` dispatch, float trig from libm (a table sine buys nothing on Apple libm, §7.2), fast tanh, no `pow` / `std::function` / allocation (DSP-05). Budget model above; Phase 2.3 gate.
- Bandlimited mode has no decimator; analytic 2× is the default.
- Unison cap 4 (both oscillators).

### Denormal Protection
- `juce::ScopedNoDenormals` in `processBlock` (existing, `PluginProcessor.cpp:729`); the decimator allpasses and the DC blocker are the only IIR state in the new path and run under it.

### Sample Rate Handling
- Phase increments, damp coefficient (a_eff), DC-blocker R, decimator designs (transition width is normalised, so the design is rate-independent) and the Chebyshev D_max all derive from fs in `prepare` / `updateBlockRate`. Nothing is hard-coded to 48 kHz except the damp law's reference (explicitly corrected).

### Latency
- Existing: distortion oversampler when not bypassed (`PluginProcessor.cpp:722`). New: constant +1 sample for the oscillator path, Quality-independent, set in `prepareToPlay` and kept by `timerCallback` (`getLatencySamples()` is non-virtual — always `setLatencySamples`, memory).

### Real-time safety of import / projection
- Decode, blur, projection, heightmap: background job only; results published by pointer; `jassert(!MessageManager::existsAndIsCurrentThread())` in the job is optional — the hard assert is `JUCE_ASSERT_MESSAGE_THREAD` in publish.

### Licence
AGPL-3.0-or-later (O-Prism). *Terrain* (GPL-3.0) credited in NOTES / CHANGELOG as the inspiration; no code copied; formulas as derived above.

## Harness design (Stage 2)

**Shape:** `plugins/O-Strata/tests/render-harness/` — `CMakeLists.txt` + `main.cpp` after `plugins/O-Bowed/tests/render-harness/` (`juce_add_console_app`, reaches back into `Source/`, built only with `OUARICON_BUILD_TESTS=ON`), plus the Stage 1 smoke harness's tricks (`stages/1-foundation/smoke/main.cpp`: `createPluginFilter()`, `setValueNotifyingHost` by ID, `prepareToPlay` / `processBlock` loop, state round-trip). **WebView editor:** the smoke harness linked the `O-Strata-param-dump` objects built with `JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0` and no editor TU (`smoke/build.sh`); `createEditor()` is already guarded (`PluginProcessor.cpp:1137-1145`) — the render harness compiles `PluginProcessor.cpp` with `JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0` and never touches `PluginEditor.cpp` (memory `pattern_render_harness_breaks_on_webview_editor`). The harness never opens an editor.

**Harness-only switches on the processor (never parameters):** `feedbackPathEnabled` (H3 negative control), `terrainKernelBypass` (H7 baseline), `TerrainKind::HarnessIdentityX` (f = x, for θ parity), `allocationCounter` hook.

**Gates (all exit-code, all print the measured numbers; WAV exports to `tests/exports/` are gitignored, goldens tracked as `.sha256` only):**

| # | Gate | Requirement | Method |
|---|------|-------------|--------|
| H1 | θ parity | FUNC-01 | Identity-X terrain + centred unit circle ⇒ y = cos θ; compare against an analytic cosine with each warp (Sync 0.5, Bend 0.5, Window 0.5, FM from B, unison 4 / detune 0.2 / width 0.5, Phase 0.25): error ≤ −80 dB (the wavetable's 2048-point linear interpolation is not bit-exact, so the reference is analytic, not `WavetableOscillator`). Also C4 pitch ± 1 cent from the spectrum. |
| H2 | Symmetry | DSP-06, FUNC-11 | Every terrain × orbit at defaults + every factory preset, C4, 1 s, Hann 8192 / hop 100 ms: h1 ≥ max − 6 dB in ≥ 95 % of windows. Negative control Centre (0, 0) / Aspect 1 / Sine Product fails. |
| H3 | Feedback | FUNC-04 | Grid (Algorithm "Trajectory feedback"): finite, |y| ≤ 1, |DC| < 1e-3; fb = 0 `memcmp`-identical to `feedbackPathEnabled = false`. |
| H4 | Pitch tracking | DSP-01 | Partials above −40 dB at C2 / C4 / C6 differ ≤ 2 (Track 1, F = 1 and F = 4); negative control Track 0 at F = 8, C6: non-harmonic energy ≥ 20 dB higher. |
| H5 | Zipper | QUAL-02 | Each of the 22 destinations stepped 10 % every 100 ms at C4 (host automation via `setValueNotifyingHost`, and via a ModWheel route stepped 8 CC values): max |y[n] − y[n−1]| ≤ 0.1 on the rendered output; negative control: smoothing ramp set to 0 s must fail. |
| H6 | Aliasing | QUAL-01 | Every terrain × orbit at defaults, C2 / C4 / C6, 2×, Track 1: exact-cycle rendering (fs·k/N as the bench), non-harmonic / strongest-harmonic ≤ −60 dB; Bandlimited with each K-orbit at C2 / C4 / C6: ≤ −90 dB and max harmonic index = D_max·K (FUNC-06 acceptance). |
| H7 | CPU | PERF-02 | 16 voices × 2 osc, unison 1, 2×, default patch, 48 kHz, 10 s: wall ÷ audio, total and with `terrainKernelBypass` → delta ≤ 12 %; also reports Bandlimited and 4× deltas and unison 4. Run in Release, pinned, best of 3; the verdict is the delta, not the wall clock alone (memory `pattern_wallclock_inside_a_stability_verdict`). |
| H8 | Allocation | DSP-05, PERF-01 | Global `operator new` counter armed around each `processBlock` across Quality changes mid-note, terrain / orbit changes, Chebyshev swaps: zero. |
| H9 | Block-size invariance | DSP-03 / smoothing | 10 s render at 64 / 256 / 1024 block sizes: identical to ≤ −100 dB (catches per-block state leaks; memory: block-size invariance traps). |
| H10 | Persistence | FUNC-08 | Save / reload with an embedded PNG: SHA-256 of a 1 s render matches; above-cap path branch; missing file → fallback + notice flag. |
| H11 | Edge continuity | DSP-04 | Hard-edged 512² PNG, Mirror and Window, orbit r = 1 crossing the border: no partial above −40 dB attributable to the edge (compare against a blurred interior orbit). |

The FUNC-05 sideband proof (40 Hz LFO on Centre X ⇒ ±40 Hz sidebands) is H5's companion check in Phase 2.1.

- Chebyshev waveshaping bandlimit identity (Puckette, *Theory and Technique*, node80) — §1.4; Clenshaw recurrence for 2-D Chebyshev series (standard).
- Tomisawa, US Pat. 4,249,447 (two-sample feedback average) — memory `O-simpleFM`.
- Halfband polyphase-IIR allpass decimation (Valenzuela & Constantinides 1983; the JUCE design method) — `kernels.h` `Halfband2x`.
- `research/wavetable-synthesis-3d-geometry.md` Sources list (KVR oversampling thread, ADAA DAFx16 paper, WebKit / WebView2 issues).
